mapper.select: SELECT imm.item_id as itemId, imm.item_name as itemName, bmm.quantity, imm.unit, skm.stock_quantity as stockQuantity, skm.defective_quantity as defectiveQuantity, skm.hold_quantity as holdQuantity FROM bom_master bmm INNER JOIN item_master imm ON bmm.child_id = imm.item_id LEFT JOIN stock_master skm ON imm.item_id = skm.item_id WHERE bmm.parent_id = #{itemId}

SELECT bmm.parent_id as parentId, imm.item_id as itemId, imm.item_name as itemName, bmm.quantity, imm.unit, skm.stock_quantity as stockQuantity, skm.defective_quantity as defectiveQuantity, skm.hold_quantity as holdQuantity FROM bom_master bmm INNER JOIN item_master imm ON bmm.child_id = imm.item_id LEFT JOIN stock_master skm ON imm.item_id = skm.item_id
